checkpoint.title: Route 10's north grass: catch two species the Pokedex has not caught, back to the nurse

events.why: The Pokedex count before the catches, off the Trainer Card.
North to the grass: Voltorb 40%, Spearow 35%, Ekans 25% (pret wild_encounters.json, FireRed).
Any foe without the caught mark is caught; the rest are run from. Spearow is caught on the Mail Glitch save, so the two are Voltorb and Ekans.
Back to the nurse, where the checkpoint started.
The Pokedex count after the catches.

metadata.notes: Starts with 01-ultra-balls' Ultra Balls. A party of six sends the catches to the PC. Once Voltorb, Spearow and Ekans are all caught the capture finds nothing new and fails out of encounters: the next species are on other routes.
